lines.text: Many learners say: I yesterday went to the park.
Better: I went to the park yesterday.
Saw her yesterday! I saw her yesterday.

data.wrong: I yesterday went to the park.
data.right: I went to the park yesterday.

native.tip: 中文习惯把时间放在动词前：“我昨天去了公园”。英语也可以把时间放句首，但放在主语和动词中间不自然，通常放句尾。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I yesterday went to the park.”😅 中文时间在前，英语时间多放句尾：“I went to the park yesterday.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。

en.hook: The time word is usually placed at
en.tip: Chinese puts time before the verb, but in English time usually goes at the end.
en.caption: Do you say “I yesterday went to the park.” 😅 In English, time usually goes at the end: “I went to the park yesterday.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
